capabilities: Translate expanded thinking blocks into Chinese as they stream
Toggle between translation and original text with one click
Switch translation engines including free Google, MyMemory fallback, and paid DeepSeek
Configure segment length, flush timing, and a term whitelist
Test the translation endpoint from the command palette
extras: Desktop only (uses Node APIs). Default engines are free with no API key; DeepSeek requires a paid key. Sends thinking-block text to third-party translation services, so users should collapse sensitive blocks or disable the plugin. Not reviewed by Obsidian staff; design docs live in docs/spec.md and docs/evidence.md.
intentEvidence: It reads the thinking blocks that Claudian renders in the chat view and adds a translation next to them.
problem: Claudian's thinking blocks stream in English, so Chinese-reading users cannot comfortably follow the reasoning without a translation.

relations.evidence: needs Claudian installed to be useful

summary: Companion plugin that translates the thinking blocks Claudian renders in chat into Chinese as they stream, only when a block is expanded.
